business_summary: Smart Digital Technology Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the media and culture business in the United States, Hong Kong, and the People's Republic of China. It also engages in film investments activities; and media and movie operations. The company was formerly known as Starlight Culture Entertainment Group Limited and changed its name to Smart Digital Technology Group Limited in July 2024. Smart Digital Technology Group Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: Smart Digital Technology Group Limited는 자회사와 함께 미국, 홍콩, 중국에서 미디어 및 문화 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 영화 투자 활동에도 참여합니다. 미디어 및 영화 운영. 이 회사는 이전에 Starlight Culture Entertainment Group Limited로 알려졌으며 2024년 7월에 Smart Digital Technology Group Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Smart Digital Technology Group Limited는 1997년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 애드미럴티에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
